title: DispaRisk: Assessing Fairness Through Usable Information

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating differences in usable information (Pointwise V-entropy) between gender groups (e.g., male vs. female or non-masculine) using the KDD Census-Income and FACET datasets, and correlating these uncertainty differences with fairness metrics like Demographic Disparity (DEMP) and Equalized Opportunity (EQOPP).

Measuring Pointwise V-entropy differences between African-American and non-African-American dialect groups in a Hate Speech dataset, and calculating the uncertainty reduction (UR) associated with specific problematic words, such as racial slurs, across different model families.
